title: Auth Control Plane principal read (v1 wire format)
description: A principal as the versioned read API serves it: its id, kind, status and revision, nothing else. Read-only, and it returns no email, display name, password hash, identity, session or credential. The object is closed, so a personal field is unrepresentable here, not merely absent. A disabled principal keeps its row.

schema_version.description: Contract identifier. A reader MUST reject an unrecognised value (G-26: unknown denies).

kind.description: Closed set; equal to the principals kind CHECK.

revision.description: Aggregate revision. 0 means the aggregate has no revision row yet; a caller treats 0 as 'none' and never as a version to send back. Integer token only; a decimal-form token is refused by every client (README, integer guard).
